description: Documented non-executor interpreter invocations the R5 rule permits. One shared data file, read by both the OpenCode guard plugin (.opencode/plugin/guard.js) and the Claude PreToolUse hook (claude_pretooluse_hook.py). An entry matches the second shell token of a python invocation exactly or as a path SUFFIX, so an absolute or relative path ending in the entry resolves to it. Each entry cites the documenting line; entries are bare script basenames wherever the documented form is a resolved/absolute path.
